SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JAN-22-2021 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO MAR-18-2021 AT 1:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. - DISCLOSURE IS MADE. PLAINTIFF HOI MENG NG IS PRESENT AND IS ASSISTED BY COURT CERTIFIED CANTONESE INTERPRETER, REBECCA CHAU. DEFENDANT MOLLY WALLACE IS PRESENT. DELMUS WOODS, COUNSEL FOR DEFENDANT'S INSURANCE COMPANY, IS PRESENT AND LISTENS TO THE COURT PROCEEDINGS ON BEHALF OF THE INSURANCE COMPANY. COURT ASKS MR. WOODS IF HE IS AWARE IF THE INSURANCE COMPANY HAS PAID ANY AMOUNTS AS TO THE PROPERTY DAMAGE, IT IS DETERMINED THAT THE PROPERTY DAMAGE HAS BEEN RESOLVED. PARTIES AGREE TO A SETTLEMENT AMOUNT OF $2000.00 FOR PAIN AND SUFFERING AND COURT COST OF $195.00, FOR TOTAL AMOUNT OF $2195.00 IN OPEN COURT. A PROGRESS REPORT IS SET FOR MARCH 18, 2021 AT 1:30 P.M. NO APPEARANCE IS REQUIRED IF THE SETTLEMENT AMOUNT IS PAID IN FULL AND THE MATTER WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE AS SETTLED. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS ARE REVIEWED AND RETURNED IN OPEN COURT. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED.(506).
